snippet.title: It Breathes - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4516370/It_Breathes

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4531470/It_Breathes_Demo

Discord Server:
https://discord.gg/aPYzeFsgxH

You wake up in a musty room. You don't know how you got here or who you are; you have no memories. You only know one thing: you have to escape. And the mysterious monster on the TV in front of you says he will help you do that.

It Breathes is a first-person VHS horror game set in an abandoned Hungarian hospital. Hide, fight, or flee while working towards your only goal: to escape.
